dogecoin.text: #Bitcoin & #dogecoin are going down like $10 Crack Ho's.   Hence the dangers of a crazy pump and dump spurred on by an eccentric Billionaire with Asperger's where a stock or crypto (which is akin to a penny stock) soars. SEC has its eyes on Musk who "says" Tesla hasnt told BITC.

#Bitcoin  #dogecoin are basically like trading hyped penny stocks. If you got in early and sold high - life is sweet. But if you Bought over $60,000? OUCH.
This sort of volatility is why cryptos wont used by ordinary people in the way they use US $ or other stable local currency.
